records.issue_text: Permission check uses AND instead of OR for team admin/owner in addGuests.handler.ts, so only users with both roles pass and non-team bookings block everyone
records.rationale:
In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the permission flag is computed as:
```ts
const isTeamAdminOrOwner =
  (await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) &&
  (await isTeamOwner(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0));
```
Using `&&` means a user must be **both** team admin and team owner to pass this check, which is likely incorrect for an “admin or owner” authorization gate and would incorrectly forbid team admins (who aren’t owners) and team owners (who aren’t admins).
